instagram.notes: Images via feed post. Videos via Reels. Official Graph API requires a publicly reachable media URL for publishing.

facebook.notes: Publishes to a Facebook Page. Binary upload is supported by Graph API.

pinterest.notes: Official Pins API is used for image Pins (image_base64). Video Pins are skipped — they need a separate media-upload flow and are not assumed here.

youtube.notes: YouTube Shorts only via YouTube Data API v3. Image-only products are skipped. Long-form uploads are not used.
